reduction_reagent.evidence: 1 × 109 cells/mL in ice-cold Buffer I (water containing 0.1 μM 1-chloro-3-tosylamido-7-amino-2-heptone (TLCK), 1 mM benzamidine, 1 mM phenyl-methyl sulfonyl fluoride (PMSF), 1 μg/mL leupeptin, and 1 μg/mL aprotinin), and hypotonic lysis was allowed to proceed for 10 min on ice (NB, T. brucei cells spontaneously lyse under these conditions).
